subject: Technical deep dive & dedicated sizing — next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Technical deep dive & dedicated sizing — next steps

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before scheduling the sizing call: 

- Business goal: reduce latency for fraud-check and reconciliation APIs that call LLMs (avg request batch = 1–4 prompts).
- Target P95 latency: <= 220ms for single-turn scoring; throughput target ~800 requests/minute during peak windows.
- Data concerns: all payloads contain PII; Atlas prefers VPC/private deployment or dedicated pools with customer-managed KMS.

Next step: schedule a ~60 minute technical deep dive / dedicated-capacity sizing session where Marissa (our SE) will walk through throughput/latency tradeoffs and we’ll sketch an initial pool configuration. Could you share 2–3 slots next week that work for your infra and fraud-engineering teams? We’ll propose a slot and send a calendar invite.

I’ve CC’d Vivek to keep leadership in the loop. We’ll prepare a short checklist and request a small sample of traffic (anonymized CSV) ahead of the call so Marissa can model burst characteristics.

Attachments: I can send a draft SOW + sample intake template if useful — let me know.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

From: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@atlaspayments.com>

Date: 2026-08-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive & dedicated sizing — next steps

Thanks Logan — useful summary.

Amit and I chatted and we’re keen to move forward with a sizing call. High level availability next week: Tuesday (Aug 4) 10–12 PT, Wednesday (Aug 5) 14–16 PT, or Friday (Aug 7) 09–11 PT. Our fraud infra lead (Amit) will attend — he’s copied.

We can provide an anonymized traffic sample. Two quick asks before the call:
1) What level of detail do you need in the sample? (columns, tokenization guidance)
2) Do you have a preferred calendar duration? We can do 45–60 minutes.

If you can propose a slot and a short pre-call checklist, we’ll route it to our security reviewer.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, Atlas Payments
priya.sinha@atlaspayments.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive & dedicated sizing — next steps

Thanks — proposing two options based on your windows: 

Option A: Tue Aug 4, 10:30–11:30 PT (60m) — preferred for us (allows full walkthrough)
Option B: Wed Aug 5, 14:30–15:15 PT (45m) — tighter, focused Q&A + sizing sketch

We’ll plan for the full hour if you can make Option A.

Pre-call checklist (short):
- Anonymized traffic sample (CSV): columns: timestamp, endpoint, avg_prompt_length_chars, response_length_chars, calls_per_minute (if available).
- Example payload sizes (actual bytes preferable).
- Any specific SLO constraints beyond P95 target.
- Contact on your infra side for calendar invite (we’ll send a Zoom link).

Marissa (copied) will run the sizing exercise. Vivek will join the first 10 minutes to align on SLAs if needed.

I’ll tentatively hold Option A on our side for now — can you confirm by EOD today?

Logan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@atlaspayments.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive & dedicated sizing — next steps

Hi Priya / Amit — quick notes from the SE side so you know what we’ll cover and what would be helpful to have before the call: 

What we’ll cover (60m agenda):
- 10m: Architecture review & security controls (VPC/KMS/audit logs)
- 20m: Workload characterization (burstiness, typical prompt/response sizes)
- 20m: Dedicated pool sizing walk-through (GPU types, batch targets, KV cache strategies)
- 10m: Open Qs + next steps (SOW, timeline)

Helpful pre-call items (if possible):
- Sample CSV (anonymized) of ~1k rows showing real distribution — we’ll run a quick profiling pass.
- Typical concurrency during peak minute vs sustained hourly average.
- Any regulatory constraints affecting retention or audit logs.

I attached a short intake template and a draft SOW outline to speed things up. If you prefer not to share files before the security review, no problem — we can still run a high-level sizing and follow with an offline model after NDA.

Attachments: redwood_sow_draft.pdf (draft SOW outline), intake_template.csv (sample schema)

See you soon — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@atlaspayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@atlaspayments.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive & dedicated sizing — next steps

Hi all — confirming Option A: Tue Aug 4, 10:30–11:30 PT. Please send the calendar invite.

Per your checklist, attaching an anonymized sample and a quick note on traffic:
- Peak concurrency: ~40 concurrent requests in a 60s window (spikes to 60 for short bursts).
- Sustained: ~12 reqs/min over the hour in our current production window.
- Avg prompt length: 420 chars; avg response length: 1,200 chars.

I’ve attached atlas_sample_traffic.csv with 1,200 anonymized rows. Security is OK with sharing this for the sizing call; they’ll route any further artifacts through our portal.

One question for Marissa: do you recommend bringing example quantized models for tradeoff discussion or should we focus purely on pool sizing and routing policies?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sinha
Head of Product, Atlas Payments
priya.sinha@atlaspayments.com

On attachments: atlas_sample_traffic.csv
